headline: Approved the April 21, 2026 meeting minutes and decided to keep tourism work at OPED instead of partnering with the Chamber.

transcript:
# Tourism Advisory Committee Meeting Minutes

**Tuesday, August 18, 2026 at 5:00 PM**

Join Zoom Meeting

Meeting ID 810 9518 4544

**Present:**

- Denis Luzuriaga (Vice-Chair)
- Kathy McKean
- Rick Purcell
- George Mulry
- Bill Alatalo

**Staff:**

- Eric Nakajima, Director of OPED
- Mishie Serrano……MIM Coordinator

**Guests:**

- Kristen Hinckley……..Holyoke Mall

### 1. Call to order

At 5:08 pm Vic-Chair Denis Luzuriaga called the August 18, 2026, Holyoke Tourism Committee Meeting to order.

### 2. Approval of April 21, 2026 Minutes

The minutes for April 21 ,2026 were approved unanimously, and the motion carried forward 5-0.

### 3. General Updates from OPED

Eric Nakajima gave a quick update.

### 4. Gaming Mitigation Funds Balance

Eric Nakajima informed the Committee that the Fund’s balance is now $165,000, a portion of which is earmarked for spending.

### 5. Possible coordination with Chamber of Commerce; Explore Holyoke as a free-standing organization

An idea was discussed about featuring Holyoke businesses at a “Small Business Saturday” event, possibly after Thanksgiving.

Denis Luzuriaga brought up the idea of TAC partnering with The Chamber, but it was decided that it would be best to keep TAC at OPED.

### 6. Revenue Stream; website sponsorship (sub-committee?)

No new updates.

### 7. TAC Assistance with planning/supporting DOH 2026

The possibility was discussed about “pausing” the event this year because of The Brick Race’s delay until the Spring.

### 8. Support Letter requests

No new updates.

### 9. Poet Laureate update

No new updates.

### 10. New Business

Kristen Hinckley, from The Holyoke Mall gave an update.

Also, the idea was discussed about adding a day to Amour Yard for Food trucks for 2027.

### 11. Old Business

Mishie Serrano suggested that now is the time to hire interns to help out with Explore Holyoke.

### 12. Next Meeting Date: Tuesday, September 15, 2026 @5:00 pm

### 13. Adjournment

[Handwritten signature]

Navae Rodriguez, Chairperson
